command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e && \
  echo '=== fmt diff before fix ===' && \
  cargo fmt --all -- --check 2>&1 | head -40 || true && \
  echo '=== applying fmt ===' && \
  cargo fmt --all && \
  echo '=== fmt verify after ===' && \
  cargo fmt --all -- --check && echo 'fmt OK' && \
  echo '=== git status ===' && \
  git status --short && \
  if [ -n "$(git status --short)" ]; then \
    echo '=== amending commit with fmt ===' && \
    git add -A && \
    git -c user.name='vac-web-agent' -c user.email='agent@vac-web.local' commit --amend --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -3 && \
    git log -1 --oneline; \
  else \
    echo 'no changes needed; commit already clean' && git log -1 --oneline; \
  fi
